evidence: Carries the Consensus label and modifies the script signature cache implementation in src/script/sigcache.cpp and src/script/sigcache.h.
rationale: Defensively standardizes signature-cache hashing to retire an unframed concatenation pattern inspired by an external incident. The author acknowledges that 'Bitcoin Core's signature-cache encoding is unambiguous for inputs accepted by its current script checker', meaning this addresses code fragility rather than an active consensus bug or vulnerability.
